sdk: sapien==3.0.3, already installed Windows wheel; no downloads or dependency changes
camera: Both states use the exact scout world pose and FOV; intrinsics scaled from 1920x1080 by 1/4

capability.isolation: One process per explicit mode; initialize no physics system; restore SDK globals on camera attachment failure
capability.positive_evidence: Raw Radiance from the same official seed must be identical to none; none HdrColor must equal Radiance; enabled HdrColor must observably change, remain finite and preserve real guides
capability.stop: Missing targets, exception, no observable filtering, or raw overwritten: stop and report limitation, no custom filter or assumed fallback

held_out_reference.average: Owned raw linear Radiance RGB only, never sRGB8; existing explicit shifted-Halton shader helper

roi.white_shell: source Panda material base_color min RGB >= .85; source IDs frozen before denoiser output; report empty ROI
roi.gripper_contour: panda_hand/leftfinger/rightfinger source IDs; 2-pixel boundary band from independent reference segmentation
roi.wood_high_frequency: original tabletop source ID; upper quartile spatial gradient selected once using independent reference only
roi.whole_image: all pixels, same camera and lighting

quality_if_capability_passes.metrics: Linear L1/RMSE normalized by fixed independent-reference 99th percentile luminance; signed bias; contour-gradient change; wood high-frequency retention; unclipped HDR ranges and clipping only at final display reported separately
quality_if_capability_passes.decision: Candidate requires >=20% whole/white RMSE reduction, no >5% RMSE regression on gripper/wood, <=10% loss in reference-normalized wood gradient energy. Each ROI/pose separately; empty evidence is unavailable, never passing. Report raw numbers even on failure.
quality_if_capability_passes.reset: 20 -> 36 -> 20, fresh attached camera per exposure; repeat 20 after closing/recreating the owner. Compare raw and filtered owned arrays exactly, or report discrepancy; no claimed temporal denoiser history
quality_if_capability_passes.cost: Per-mode owner setup, camera attach, take_picture plus synchronous target readbacks, all target copies, display/PNG/NPZ separately and total wall. No unsupported claim of separate GPU denoise time.
quality_if_capability_passes.bounded_dispatches: No 4096spp or 1080p dispatch; first capability only, quality requires a subsequent explicit execution slot

limitations: SDK enum/getter and DLL presence are not proof of functioning camera denoising
Official environment miss shader clamps each channel to 100; actual source peak67 stays below that known clamp, but do not claim unrestricted physical HDR
Albedo/Normal guides are first-bounce data overwritten per primary sample in the shipped raygen, not sample-averaged guides
Results concern these two poses, fixed daylight/materials and reduced resolution, not arbitrary scenes or 1080p quality
A prior 4096spp 960x540 independent dispatch lost the device; this protocol deliberately uses bounded independent raw batches
